evidence: Merged 02c05863 (#2107, closes #1466): invoices.service.ts duplicate() now calls writeCreatedInvoiceLedger(tx, copy) inside the copy's own transaction (the same private writer create() uses), so a copied regulated line gets its RegulatedSalesLedger SALE rows; pinned by invoices.duplicate.spec.ts and invoice-duplicate-ledger.db.spec.ts
Merged 262a2a75 (#1189, web, closes #1702) and ef2bf3a4 (#2652, mobile): a CANCELLED order line shows no delivery progress line on either client
Merged 23ee3a2e (#2627, closes #2062): the PageHeader action slot wraps its content, so the customers-list toolbar no longer overflows at 390px
Merged 23ee3a2e (#2627, closes #2062): the PageHeader action slot wraps its content, so the invoices-list action toolbar wraps at 390px
Merged 3f0c9c28 (#2632, closes #2070): the partial-invoice remaining check and the line write run under one lock/CAS inside the transaction, so concurrent partials can no longer over-bill a line
Merged 9a4f3c19 (#2625, supersedes #2068): the web invoices-list table scrolls horizontally inside its container instead of clipping at 390px

Merged 2666aa67 (#2301, supersedes #1347): createPartialFromOrder caps remaining-to-bill at the delivered basis on a DELIVERED order instead of qty - invoicedQty, so 'invoice remaining' can no longer bill undelivered quantity

Merged 88d0671f (#2637, closes #1485): web PurchaseOrdersTab shows @routeflow/pricing poDisplayTotal (stored totalAmount when positive, else the summed stored line totals) instead of a field the API never sent, so the Total column no longer reads $0.00
